install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-ebf81b9a72ca904f7a4b，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-webui-market-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ebf81b9a72ca904f7a4b.html
posts.en:
dsh-webui-market-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ebf81b9a72ca904f7a4b.html
